description:
`ConstExt::<E>::new()` in crates/gf2-core/src/field/extension.rs constructs an extension witness for any `ConstSimpleExtension` without validating the declared configuration, but its name does not carry the `_unchecked` suffix the caller-trusted-fast-paths invariant prescribes for validation-skipping paths. Concrete carriers (e.g. `ConstQuotient::extension_unchecked`) follow the convention; the generic witness constructor predates the invariant (its Declared basis is owner-ratified per epic ae03bcd0 rulings R-16/R-17) and touches the QuadraticExt/CubicExt witnesses, so it was reported as a footprint finding by 0e706bf5 rather than changed in place.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The generic validation-skipping construction path is either renamed with the `_unchecked` suffix (with a deprecation or migration for existing callers) or wrapped so the un-suffixed path validates, per the invariant; rustdoc cites the invariant either way.
- [hard] REQ-02: All in-tree callers compile and tests pass; no behavioral change to validated paths.
title: Name or wrap the validation-skipping ConstExt::new per caller-trusted-fast-paths
